newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian customs seize heroin worth $7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Indian customs seize heroin worth $7 mln.

text.p: Indian customs officials and border guards seized 25 kg (55 lb) of heroin in a search near the Pakistani border, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said on Tuesday.

It said customs authorities and the Border Security Force seized the heroin, valued at an international street price of around 250 million rupees ($7.0 million), on Sunday during a search at Abdullain village near the Pakistani border close to Jammu, winter capital of the state of Jammu and Kashmir.
The news agency did not give other details.
